name: (03) Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit) — 2 Intermediate — Drain Resolve

system.description:
The infernalist's grip on a victim's will deepens until they can smother the very capacity to recover it, sinking the subject into something like deep depression.

Within five minutes of a successful Mind Leech, issue a Mental Challenge against the same target. On a win, the victim must spend three Willpower Traits, rather than one, to refresh their Mental Traits, and should roleplay the crushing effects, which last until the next sunrise. The power requires line of sight. Retest with Subterfuge.
